shots.image_prompt: {HERO} stands in a sunny park with green grass and trees, full body, centered, both paws on his hips, standing tall with a confident, ready-to-go smile. {STYLE}
shots.prompt_en: The little orange fox cub stretches his arms up high, then puts his paws on his hips with a confident smile, tail swishing. Static camera. Light park ambience with birdsong, no speech, no music.

shots.image_prompt: {HERO} stands in a sunny park with green grass, mid-jump in a small happy hop on the spot with both feet just off the ground, arms up, big proud smile. Full body, centered. {STYLE}
shots.prompt_en: The little orange fox cub does small happy hops on the spot, arms up, laughing proudly, tail bouncing. Static camera. Light park ambience, no speech, no music.

shots.image_prompt: {HERO} stands in a sunny park with green grass, clapping his paws together happily with a huge proud smile, eyes closed with joy. Full body, centered. {STYLE}
shots.prompt_en: The little orange fox cub claps his paws together happily several times with a big proud smile, swaying a little, tail swishing. Static camera. Light park ambience, no speech, no music.
